sources.title: Visas to Jordan
sources.officialityEvidence: The live page identifies itself as the official Jordan Tourism Board site and publishes a nationality-by-nationality On-Arrival and Procedure table. It is the current direct source for the Morocco conditional row and confirms the other four codes are not named.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Morocco | Not-Applicable (Females 16 - 60) | Visa can be obtained upon arrival.

sources.title: Restricted and Non Restricted Countries (Nationalities)
sources.officialityEvidence: Jordan's Ministry of Interior publishes the live restricted-nationality schedule, last updated 9 November 2025. It expressly defines non-restricted status only as not needing prior approval, without mapping a visa-free, arrival or electronic result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Non-Restricted Countries: Countries that do not need prior approval.

unresolved.reason: Greece is not named in Jordan Tourism Board's live nationality table. The Ministry's non-restricted definition only removes prior approval and does not distinguish visa-free, electronic or arrival issuance; no complement is inferred.
